description: This Java source file defines the class RetrieveThingsResponse, which models the response to a RetrieveThings command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON and other data, handles JSON serialization/deserialization, and provides access to the retrieved 'Thing' objects.

classes.name: RetrieveThingsResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response to a RetrieveThings command, encapsulating retrieved 'Thing' objects, handling JSON serialization/deserialization, and providing methods for response creation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods for creating instances of RetrieveThingsResponse with various input types such as JSON strings, JSON objects, lists of Thing objects, or plain JSON strings.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string or JSON object, deserializing the response.

methods.name: getThings
methods.description: Returns the list of retrieved Thing objects.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the provided JSON entity.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the given DittoHeaders.

methods.name: getThingStream
methods.description: Creates a Stream of Thing objects from a JsonArray.

methods.name: lazyLoadThingsJsonArray
methods.description: Lazy loads the JsonArray of 'things' from their JSON string representation.

methods.name: getEntityPlainString
methods.description: Returns the plain JSON string of 'things'.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON value representing the 'things' array.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the payload to a JsonObjectBuilder, including 'things' and 'namespace'.
